findings.description: g1-foundations/src/postgres-uow.ts:16 replaces the scope's bound authenticating lookup with controller_authority(), which ignores sessionCredential. contracts.ts:53 invokes only that replacement. Consequently, after minting a scope, revoking or expiring its session in the original lookup does not prevent subsequent repository reads or writes while database membership remains unchanged. The scope has no expiry or invalidation mechanism. Preserve current session authentication alongside the transaction-locked database authority check, and add a real PostgreSQL regression where the original lookup denies a previously issued scope.

The required original command/capability artifacts cannot be inspected within this read-only copy. g1-foundations-acceptance.json indexes historical logs at external absolute paths; current observations provide output tails and bindings but no accessible complete raw files. These support the reported execution outcomes, but do not complete the requested artifact and historical-failure verification. Supply immutable copies of the complete current command logs and original capability/measurement artifacts, with candidate/environment/procedure bindings and hashes, inside the permitted review material.
